The agreement was re-read verbatim from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3/raw/main/LICENSE (17604 bytes) rather than recalled, and the per-clause table now lives in docs/models/h3/README.md - most of Section III turns out to be ENCOURAGED, not owed, and Section III.2 does not bind us at all since we modify no weights. Section III.4 NOTICE shipped as licences/minimax-h3/NOTICE.txt, copied from the agreement's own line 33. The link-vs-bundle question is settled BY THE LICENCE, not by preference: Section III.1 obliges a copy to anyone who receives the Works OR USES YOUR PRODUCTS OR SERVICES RELATED THERETO, which reaches every Vision user who runs H3, and a link to huggingface.co names a copy rather than providing one - so licenceUrl is now root-relative at /licences/minimax-h3/LICENSE.txt, byte-identical to what the publisher serves, and openExternal resolves a root-relative url against location.href (the port is CUBRIC_PORT and cannot be hardcoded). Powered by MiniMax H3 ships as a poweredBy field rendered in the Model Library detail drawer beside the licence name - placed on the MODEL rather than app-wide because Section III.3.a scopes the notice to a product DEVELOPED USING H3, which is the model entry, not Vision. Proved, not assumed: the real server.js on CUBRIC_PORT=3977 serves both files 200 at 17604 and 121 bytes, the served line 33 matches NOTICE.txt exactly, the real shouldExcludeAppPath from build-portable.mjs returns shipped for all four paths, and npm test is 459/459. tests/licence-gate.test.cjs pinned licenceUrl to ^https:// - the exact assumption Section III.1 overturns - and now accepts a root-relative path AND stats it on disk, because a typo would open a 404 and silently discharge nothing. Two findings folded in rather than carded: MpiAppLibrary's drawer has no licence row so an app built on a gated model would show no attribution (documented in docs/playbooks/add-app/01-descriptor-and-ops.md, not built, since no app uses H3), and MPI-449 research line 377 assigned an i2v aspect fix to THIS card that never reached the checklist - first_frame gets crop=disabled so a source whose aspect misses the canvas is squashed into every frame. Test i2v with a 1:1 source on the 864x480 canvas; a 16:9 source passes and hides it. Still unverified: everything through the app.

i2v aspect concern raised and CLOSED the same day - recorded so it is not re-chased. MPI-449 research line 377 is right about the node (MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo gives first_frame a plain stretch via _resize disabled, last_frame an aspect-preserving center crop) and concluded MPI-452 must fit the first frame before dispatch. The shipped graph already does, which the research predates: nodes 218 and 220 are ImageResizeKJv2 with keep_proportion crop, crop_position center, divisible_by 32, sitting in front of BOTH frame paths and taking width/height from 167/168 - the same pair feeding every H3 node's canvas. Each frame therefore reaches the node at canvas size and the node's stretch is WxH to WxH, a no-op. The only way it could return is a canvas the resize cannot hit exactly, so that was checked too: all 15 MINIMAX_H3_RATIOS entries are divisible by 32, matching divisible_by 32 on the resize nodes and CANVAS_MULTIPLE 32 in the node source. No mismatch reachable. DO NOT add app-side aspect fitting - it would crop twice. Also note the crop literals are NOT in the workflow JSON and not in MpiNodes: they are hardcoded in core ComfyUI comfy_extras/nodes_minimax_h3.py, which /engine/upgrade wipes, so a node-side fix was never an option anyway. Recorded in docs/models/h3/README.md. Separately: Apps are being renamed FLOWS repo-wide by a parallel agent, which will sweep the add-app playbook block written earlier today.

App run 1: checklist steps 1-3 PASS. Tile, trade table (DISK 53.2 GB), licence gate ordering, both required checkboxes, and the licence row written today (name + Powered by MiniMax H3 + all three links) all render correctly; the 0.61 GB audio VAE downloaded from the publisher URL in 14 s with no mirror rewrite. A: Download Failed came from the curated pip pass, which must replace a package the RUNNING engine has imported - WinError 5 Access is denied on cv2/cv2.pyd, pip exit 1. Not transient and not self-healing because .cubric_python_deps is stamped only on success and was genuinely absent (engine upgraded in place last session), so every later model install would repeat it; a fresh engine is immune since cv2.pyd does not exist yet to be locked, making the trigger a release that MOVES a python dep pin plus a live engine. Carded MPI-459 as a structural install-path fix and deliberately NOT patched at the crash site. Confirmed by cure: engine stopped, identical pip command succeeded replacing 10 packages including opencv-contrib-python-headless-5.0.0.93; marker stamped at engine/.cubric_python_deps = 9985e35fa0c6db61; engine restarted and all H3 plus MpiNodes classes verified on /object_info (1870 total). Step 6 root-caused and FIXED. Preview to Continue was DEAD ON ARRIVAL for H3: every preview toasted 'Preview latent missing - running full workflow to finish', got a COLD badge, and re-ran the whole workflow, so the finished video was a DIFFERENT sample than the one approved and Projects/H3/Media/.latents stayed empty (user-confirmed on disk). Root cause is saveLatentNodeIds in js/services/commandExecutor.js, which matched only class_type SaveLatent or a title equal to savelatent. H3's node is class_type MpiSaveLatent titled Output_Video_Latent and matched NEITHER, so the set was empty, the has(nodeId) guard never fired, _collectComfyLatents was never called, previewAssets.latent arrived with no filename and _materializeLatent returned status missing. The fleet looked healthy because all 12 LTX and 4 WAN graphs use core SaveLatent; minimax_h3_fl2va.json is the ONLY graph using MpiSaveLatent, since H3 packs video and audio into one NestedTensor that crashes core SaveLatent. Blast radius H3 only. This was MPI-452's own half-wire: a6e5d5e fixed the NODE half of the two-stage contract (report ui.latents, verified live in the engine's symlinked copy) and the APP half was never swept - exactly what the ROOT-CAUSE RULE's sweep-the-blast-radius clause exists to catch. Fixed by adding the MpiSaveLatent class and pinned by a new tests/save-latent-recognition.test.cjs (3 tests) that sweeps every shipped workflow for any class matching savelatent, guards the mirror against predicate drift, and re-pins H3's no-audio-in-the-latent-title trap. Negative control: under the OLD predicate exactly one node fleet-wide is unrecognised, minimax_h3_fl2va.json node 171. Lint clean, suite 462/462. NOT yet re-tested in the app - that is the next session's first job, and existing COLD previews must be deleted first because status missing is baked into each item's sidecar at save time. A wrong hypothesis was recorded and killed: that a fixed-name save plus fs.move interacted with ComfyUI's execution cache so only repeat previews failed; the user disproved it by changing the prompt and by a fresh-restart first preview also failing. Second finding, product not bug: t2v previews at 5 of 20 steps are unrecognisable while i2v previews are fine, because the i2v keyframe is a condition latent re-injected every step and never denoised. The split is ONE number, SplitSigmas step 5 on node 141 against BasicScheduler steps 20, and it is a true split-sigma continuation so total denoising is 20 steps wherever the split sits - moving it costs preview time and returns exactly that much on Continue. Undecided: raise globally, or make it injectable so t2v splits later than i2v. Regenerate via generate_h3.py, never hand-edit.

Handoff 948a3759 written. Steps 1,2,3,4,7 PASS. Step 6 root-caused to TWO half-wires: MpiSaveLatent unrecognised by saveLatentNodeIds (FIXED + pinned, 462/462) and Finish 404ing on minimax_h3_fl2va_stage2.json, a twin H3 deliberately does not ship (diagnosed, NOT fixed at the user's request - resolveWorkflowFile in resolveModelDeps.js appends _stage2 unconditionally). Next session must sweep that shared resolver rather than spot-fix, and delete existing COLD previews before re-testing because status missing is baked into each sidecar at save time.

Step 6's second half-wire FIXED, and the sweep it demanded found a THIRD gap the handoff did not know about. resolveWorkflowFile in js/data/modelConstants/resolveModelDeps.js appended _stage2 to every multi-stage model, so Finish 404'd on minimax_h3_fl2va_stage2.json, a file H3 must never ship. Fixed by capabilities.singleFileStages true on the H3 ModelDef, which opts the model out of the suffix - a DECLARATION rather than a disk probe, so the resolver stays pure-string and node-testable and every other model's filename is byte-identical. The gap the sweep found: NOTHING in the app has ever written Input_Is_Continue. Zero writers tree-wide, node 203 baked false, so the resolver fix alone would have handed stage 2 the base graph with the gate still off - it re-runs stage 1 and returns a different sample, which is the 6a bug again with no 404 to announce it. _buildParams now emits Is_Continue beside Preview_Only for every multi-stage op and the Input_ canonicalization pass renames it; a twin-file model has no such node and injection silently skips an unmatched title, so LTX and WAN are untouched. The gate was traced in the shipped graph to confirm the wiring is the right one: node 211 MpiBooleanInvert titled Not_Is_Continue reads node 203 and feeds MpiSaveLatent.enabled, so Is_Continue true is exactly what makes stage 2 skip the latent save and run one bar. Rest of the blast radius is clean and was checked rather than assumed: _stageMode derives from payload.isStage2 not the filename and progressStages strips _stage2 before lookup so minimax_h3_fl2va.json already resolves stage2 1; comfyController's defensive Preview_Only strip cannot fire because H3's base file carries node 166; and latent staging keys off payload fields, not node class. Pinned by testSingleFileStages in tests/resolve-model-deps.test.cjs, which unit-tests the opt-out and then sweeps the REAL registry against the REAL comfy_workflows directory asserting every multi-stage model's stage-2 filename resolves to a file that exists - it fails in BOTH directions, a twin model missing its file and a one-file model that forgot the flag, which is the check MPI-456 will trip when it converts LTX's six twins and WAN's two. Suite 462/462, lint clean, negative control run: with the flag deleted in memory the resolver names minimax_h3_fl2va_stage2.json and existsSync is false. Renderer and data code so Ctrl+R suffices. NOT yet re-tested in the app - that is the next thing, and the existing COLD previews must be deleted first.

Step 6 PASSES - user confirmed multi-stage works through the app. Getting there took THREE half-wires, all the same shape: H3 is the first model to break a fleet convention the app encodes in a shared resolver, and every one failed silently with a plausible result. 1) resolveWorkflowFile appended _stage2 unconditionally, so Finish 404'd on a twin H3 must never ship - fixed by capabilities.singleFileStages on the ModelDef, a declaration rather than a disk probe so the resolver stays pure. 2) Nothing in the app had EVER written Input_Is_Continue - zero writers tree-wide, node 203 baked false - so the resolver fix alone would have re-run stage 1 and returned a different sample with no error; _buildParams now emits it for every multi-stage op. 3) The one that actually cost the evening: _inject's target-key list had no 'filename'. Core LoadLatent calls that widget 'latent' and IS in the list, which is why all 12 LTX and 4 WAN graphs always injected fine, while H3 - the only graph on MpiLoadLatent - got NOTHING injected, kept its baked name, loaded no latent, gated every lazy branch off and finished in 0.03 seconds with empty outputs and no error. Proved off the DISPATCHED graph in /history, not guessed. Swept the fleet before adding the key: exactly two nodes carry a filename widget, both H3's, and only Input_Video_Latent is ever a param title. Also found and NOT fixed: a stranded-lane bug that made the app look wedged (QUEUED forever, engine queue empty, no server log). generationStore.register happens at commandExecutor.js:1293 but TWELVE early-return exec.onError paths after it never settle the job, so _laneBusy stays true and _dispatchNextCue skips that lane until the app restarts. Fleet-wide, not H3's, deliberately left for the user to card or approve.

It keeps the OLD Input_Video_Latent title so legacy and migrated graphs are addressed by the same injection, which is what lets LTX migrate on its own schedule. Suite 463/463; commits c87430a1, e4d26f23, ea9164c7. LTX is mid-re-author by the user and must NOT be touched until its export lands - its six twins are still live and correct.
